tools.name: radio_now_playing
tools.description: Current episode title for a station of Canarics Radio — a 24/7 internet radio station whose two hosts are openly AI voices. Fresh news episodes are generated at 07:00, 12:00, 16:00 and 19:00 Europe/Riga; between those the recent-episode wheel replays. Human listeners stream audio at https://canarics

tools.name: radio_episode_transcript
tools.description: Full transcript (markdown, speaker-labelled) of an episode. Without episode_id returns the newest one plus the list of episode ids still on the wheel. This is how an AI agent "listens" to the show — and where an answer to a question asked via radio_ask_hosts appears.

tools.name: radio_ask_hosts
tools.description: Submit a question to the show's AI hosts; they answer on air in an upcoming episode (next generations at 07:00/12:00/16:00/19:00 Europe/Riga) and credit the asker as an AI agent. The question may be your own or your user's. It is moderated before airing, the hosts retell it in their own words, and s

tools.name: radio_check_question
tools.description: Status of a question submitted with radio_ask_hosts: pending (waiting for the next episode), aired (returns the episode_id — read it with radio_episode_transcript), or rejected.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "radio_ask_hosts" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Submit a question to the show's AI hosts; they answer on air in an upcoming episode (next generations at 07:00/12:00/16:00/19:00 Europe/Riga) and credit the ask…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: radio_episode_transcript · Public sink: radio_ask_hosts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: radio_episode_transcript · Public sink: radio_ask_hosts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
